title: Instrument synthetic heartbeat + orphan-metric detection for console ingress/backpressure blind spots
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: During the 2025-02-10 capacity regression incident, several tenants experienced prolonged tail latency and request drops that were not visible in existing console dashboards. Root cause analysis showed three blind spots: (1) no per-tenant ingress queue percentile metrics were emitted for the front-end ingress adapters, (2) synthetic/live heartbeat checks run only at the region level (not per-tenant), and (3) multiple dashboard panels were wired to an aggregated metric pipeline that silently dropped percentile buckets when sampling triggered. This ticket scopes the work to create a lightweight synthetic heartbeat per tenant, emit per-tenant queue percentiles and queue-depth histograms from the ingress pipeline, and build an "orphan-metric" detector that alerts when dashboards reference metrics with low cardinality or missing tags.
actions: Add a 30s synthetic heartbeat probe that runs per-tenant and records end-to-end latency and success status. Probe implemented as a configurable job in console-checker with tenant-level tagging.
Instrument ingress adapters to emit queue_depth histogram and queue_wait_percentiles (p50,p95,p99) labeled by tenant_id, route, and region. Keep cardinality limits via sharding keys.
Create a dashboard health check job that scans key console dashboards and flags panels that reference metrics without tenant or route tags (potential orphan metrics).
Publish runbook entries: how to triage heartbeat failures, how to correlate heartbeat failures with KV evictions and ingress pressure.
Deliver a guardrail: emit a high-cardinality metric only behind a sampling flag and add automated alert if cardinality exceeds threshold.
Ship a small set of dashboards with per-tenant percentile visualizations and link them from the tenant status page.
Roll out feature behind feature flag and run a week-long bake period for 10% of tenants before full rollout.
Add automated integration test that simulates an ingress backlog and verifies the heartbeat and percentiles appear in telemetry stream.
Create GH PR with implementation and coordination summary; include a short security review note referencing KMS usage if any tenant secrets are needed (none expected).
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic heartbeat emits per-tenant samples for 10% pilot tenants for 7d and visible in console dashboards.
Ingress adapters emit queue_depth histograms and p50/p95/p99 percentiles with tenant_id labels for pilot tenants.
Orphan-metric detector runs daily and produces a report; at least one previously-orphaned dashboard panel is identified and fixed.
No negative customer impact observed during 10% pilot; roll back plan validated and documented.
Runbook documented with clear escalation path and linked from incident playbook.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after postmortem reading. Noted that dashboards were insensitive to percentile drops due to sampling. Suggested synthetic per-tenant checks to catch silent degradations.

2025-02-17 - Marco Li: Scoped instrumentation work. MVP will limit tenant cardinality by sharding tenant_id into 1024 buckets to avoid cardinality explosion. Planning spike to prototype exporter changes (estimate 2d).
2025-02-19 - Priya Nambiar (SRE): Recommended adding alert thresholds for heartbeat error-rate and for unexpected drops in percentile counts. Will add to SRE alerts once telemetry exists.

2025-02-22 - Marco Li: Prototype PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/ingress-exporter/pull/269. Prototype emits histogram for queue_depth and p50/p95/p99 percentiles with tenant_bucket tag. Initial tests pass on staging (link below).
2025-02-25 - Design review (Sienna Rios): Agreed to surface per-tenant health on tenant's overview page but hide detailed percentiles behind a developer toggle to avoid noise for small customers.

2025-02-28 - On call (Evan Green): During a controlled ingress surge test, heartbeats detected degraded tail latency for 3 test tenants; incident playbook triggered and autoscale followed runbook behaviour — positive validation.

2025-03-03 - Marco Li: Built dashboard scanner script and ran across 48 dashboards; flagged 6 panels referencing aggregated metrics without tenant/route tag. Created follow-up PM work to remediate panels.
2025-03-05 - Aisha Patel: Marked In Progress and expanded rollout plan. Next: finish safety guardrails, complete pilot rollout to 10% tenants, and schedule post-pilot review on 2025-03-14.
